# TPC-DS-OBT Q44

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT asceding.rnk, item_i_product_name AS best_performing, item_i_product_name AS worst_performing FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT item_sk, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rank_col ASC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT obt.item_sk AS item_sk, AVG(obt.net_profit) AS rank_col FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.store_sk = 1 AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.item_sk HAVING AVG(obt.net_profit) > 0.9 * (SELECT AVG(obt.net_profit) AS rank_col FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.store_sk = 1 AND ship_customer_sk IS NULL) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.store_sk)) AS V1) AS V11 WHERE rnk < 11) AS asceding CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT item_sk, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rank_col DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT obt.item_sk AS item_sk, AVG(obt.net_profit) AS rank_col FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.store_sk = 1 AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.item_sk HAVING AVG(obt.net_profit) > 0.9 * (SELECT AVG(obt.net_profit) AS rank_col FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.store_sk = 1 AND ship_customer_sk IS NULL) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.store_sk)) AS V2) AS V21 WHERE rnk < 11) AS descending WHERE (asceding.rnk = descending.rnk AND obt.item_sk = asceding.item_sk AND obt.item_sk = descending.item_sk) AND channel = 'store' ORDER BY asceding.rnk LIMIT 100
```
